mentions.name: Kavla
mentions.description: A canvas-based data workspace that puts a user's data and analysis on a single canvas instead of forcing constant alt-tabbing between tools. Built with tldraw, DuckDB, and Cloudflare, with plans to explore the canvas as an interface for AI agents.
mentions.problem: People working with data have to alt-tab between many tools constantly.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've worked with data my entire career. We need to alt tab so much. What if we put it all on a canvas? Thats what I'm building with Kavla!
